integrity: Every proper simple game through five players is enumerated from its minimal-winning antichain. Deegan–Packel and Shapley–Shubik are each computed independently in two exact formulations, divergent games are canonicalized under all player relabelings, and every canonical divergent class is independently checked to be weighted.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for proper simple games through five players and compares weak player rankings rather than numerical distances. The general possibility that Deegan–Packel violates desirability is prior; the accepted contribution is the complete sharp proper-game layer, exact count, reversal-only signature, and nine-class quotient.
title: Complete five-player reversal layer for Deegan–Packel versus Shapley–Shubik
